title: DASH / Feature : Synchronize DASH automatically to stop alerts
symptom: The DASH beeps when it reaches the minimum reservoir set by user, at 70 hours and 72 hours of use (as well as before 80 hours etc). When we hear these beeps, we are obliged to open AAPS, go to DASH tab, force an actualization so that AAPS can show the 'Accept alerts' button which permits to stop the beeps.
